{{Quote|Findin' Clabburn's likely to be the last mistake you ever make.|[[Fenn Gilbrantes]], retired Yarith Sector Ranger|<ref name="Rough" />}}
'''Clabburn the Elder''' was a [[Mugaari]] [[Realspace/Legends|space]] [[Pirate/Legends|pirate]] notorious for targeting the [[Greater Javin/Legends|Greater Javin]] region of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]] during the final [[Standard decade|decades]] before the fall of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. Particularly known for his ruthless and harsh treatment of [[Sentience/Legends|sentient]] beings captured during his raids, Clabburn and his men set up roving [[Asteroid/Legends|asteroid]] bases in the [[Hoth asteroid field/Legends|Hoth asteroid field]], from where they attacked [[Luxury liner/Legends|luxury liners]] transporting wealthy passengers to the nearby [[Bespin/Legends|Bespin]] resort of [[Cloud City/Legends|Cloud City]] along the [[Anoat trade corridor]]. Clabburn was perhaps most well-known among [[Spacer/Legends|spacer]] legend for planting giant [[Exogorth/Legends|exogorths]] at the entrances of his discarded asteroid bases in the [[Hoth system/Legends|Hoth]] [[Asteroid field/Legends|belt]] to avoid being captured by local authorities and to devour would-be pursuers. 

After Clabburn carried out his final and greatest raid, pilfering the riches of the ''[[Malachite Scent]]'', a royal [[Shistavanen/Legends|Shistavanen]] [[Star Cruiser/Legends|star cruiser]], the Mugaari disappeared from the [[Hyperspace route/Legends|space lanes]] for good. His enduring legacy among the Javin paved the way for his son, [[Clabburn the Younger]], to fashion his own pirating career after that of his father during the height of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], leading many to believe that the original Clabburn had returned to his raiding ways.

==Biography==
===Criminal activities===
{{Quote|Used to tell his pirates to take as many captives alive as they could. Not for ransom. For spacin'. Grim to say, but he liked to see 'em die.|Fenn Gilbrantes|<ref name="Rough" />}}
For centuries leading up to the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], the [[Hoth asteroid field/Legends|Hoth asteroid field]], a wildly chaotic [[Asteroid field/Legends|asteroid belt]] occupying the farthest [[Orbit/Legends|orbit]] of the remote [[Hoth system/Legends|Hoth system]], was a favorite hideout for [[Smuggler/Legends|smugglers]] and [[Realspace/Legends|space]] [[Pirate/Legends|pirates]] hoping to elude legal authority.<ref name="Illustrated" /> [[Reproduction/Legends|Born]] [[Standard decade/Legends|decades]] before [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]],<ref name="Date note" /> the pirate named Clabburn was widely accepted as the most notorious<ref name="Illustrated" /> and fearsome of these criminals. A [[Gender/Legends|male]] member of the [[Mugaari]] [[Species/Legends|species]],<ref name="Rough" /> [[Color/Legends|grayish]]-green-skinned [[Humanoid/Legends|humanoids]] native to the [[Javin sector/Legends|Javin sector]]&mdash;previously known as Mugaari Space, in the [[Greater Javin/Legends|Greater Javin]] region of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]]<ref name="Javin">{{Wizards|url=default.asp?x=starwars/article/sw20040325web|text=Galactic Gazetteer: Hoth and the Greater Javin|int=Galactic Gazetteer: Hoth and the Greater Javin}}</ref>&mdash;Clabburn was popularly depicted as a hairy, oily being with no compassion for other [[Sentience/Legends|sentient]] lifeforms.<ref name="Illustrated" />

[[File:AnoatSectorMap.jpg|thumb|right|250px|The Greater Javin, Clabburn's target area]]

During the final [[Standard decade|decades]] before the collapse of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]], Clabburn raided the Greater Javin, a backwater region of space known for smugglers and pirates like Clabburn<ref name="Javin" /> himself.<ref name="Rough" /> Feared by many throughout the Javin,<ref name="Rough" /> he targeted the region of the [[Anoat sector/Legends|Anoat sector]] bordering the [[Yarith sector/Legends|Yarith sector]], an area that included, among others, the planets [[Bespin/Legends|Bespin]], [[Anoat/Legends|Anoat]], [[Hoth/Legends|Hoth]], and [[Ison/Legends|Ison]], along the [[Ison Trade Corridor/Legends|Ison Corridor]] [[Hyperspace route/Legends|trade route]]. He tended to concentrate his attacks specifically along the [[Anoat trade corridor]],<ref name="Illustrated" /> a portion of the larger Ison Corridor that had become defunct prior to the [[Battle of Hoth/Legends|Battle of Hoth]],<ref name="Rough" /> an event that occurred in [[3 ABY/Legends|3 ABY]].<ref name="NEC">''[[The New Essential Chronology]]''</ref> His exploits earned him the epithet "the scourge of the [[Anoat system/Legends|Anoat system]]."<ref name="Javin" />

The Mugaari pirate took great advantage of the Hoth [[Asteroid/Legends|asteroid]] field's lethal tumbling rock hazards by forming a series of major strongholds on the belt's largest asteroids that held scant [[Atmosphere/Legends|atmospheres]].<ref name="Javin" /> Clabburn and his forces would strike from the confines of the belt, lying in wait along the most populated hyperlanes running through the Ison trade corridor for passing [[Luxury liner/Legends|luxury liners]] heading for the extravagant resorts of Bespin's [[Cloud City/Legends|Cloud City]]. Clabburn knew that these luxury liners carried only the wealthiest of tourists.<ref name="Illustrated" />

His forces often executed a particularly ruthless method of attacking targets. His [[Starship/Legends|ships]] would swarm a luxury liner before immobilizing the [[Engine/Legends|engines]] with a series of precision [[Blaster/Legends|blaster]] shots. With the craft neutralized, the pirates would exit their own ships in [[Environment suit/Legends|vacuum suits]] to crawl along the outer hull of their crippled prey, planting small charges that would detonate and puncture the hull. The liner's interior would devoid of breathable air, killing all passengers on board instantly without struggle, and without allowing them to see whom their attackers were. Free to pillage as they pleased, Clabburn and his men would then dismantle the ship at their leisure, taking whatever treasures caught their fancy, before destroying the ship entirely in order to eliminate any evidence of their crime.<ref name="Illustrated" />

===Pursuits and disappearance===
{{Quote|He kept moving from one planetoid to another, always covering his tracks and leaving unpleasant booby traps for anyone who might be one step behind him.|Alliance to Restore the Republic [[Major/Legends|Major]] [[Kem Monnon/Legends|Kem Monnon]], on Clabburn|<ref name="Illustrated" />}}
Clabburn's actions earned the ire of many. [[Bounty hunter/Legends|Bounty hunters]], police forces, and vengeful relatives of the besieged hunted for his secret asteroid base for [[Standard year/Legends|years]] without success&mdash;Clabburn was always one step ahead of his pursuers. He constantly relocated his base from one asteroid to the next, always covering his tracks and leaving booby traps behind for anyone who might be resourceful enough to catch up with him. At the entrances of his discarded asteroid bases, Clabburn installed giant [[Worm/Legends|wormlike]] creatures known [[Exogorth/Legends|exogorths]], or space slugs, which were able to subsist on the nutrients of the rock itself in little to no atmosphere. Occasionally, the space slugs would devour [[Bounty/Legends|bounty]] hunters or law-enforcement [[Troop/Legends|troops]] who entered a cavernous opening in an asteroid, believing it to be Clabburn's haven.<ref name="Illustrated" />

[[File:Spaceslug_swk.jpg|thumb|left|150px|An exogorth, which Clabburn used to defend himself from pursuers]]
Sometime before the inauguration of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]],<ref name="NEC" /> Clabburn carried out his final raid. He made off with the vaunted riches of the ''[[Malachite Scent]]'', a royal [[Shistavanen/Legends|Shistavanen]] [[Star Cruiser/Legends|star cruiser]] lost along the Anoat trade corridor. The pilfering of the ''Malachite Scent'' was easily the biggest score of Clabburn's career. He captured some of the greatest treasures of the [[Uvena system/Legends|Uvena systems]] and outlying regions&mdash;more wealth than he had ever imagined. However, the [[Cruiser/Legends|cruiser's]] crew was herded into [[Escape pod/Legends|escape pods]] and jettisoned from the ship, which led many to believe that it was not Clabburn at all who had struck the '' Malachite Scent'', since he typically murdered his victims. Although Clabburn made the move intending to throw the local [[Sector Ranger/Legends|Sector Rangers]] off his track, a surviving [[Astromech droid/Legends|astromech droid]] made a brief [[Hologram/Legends|holo-recording]] of the incident to confirm Clabburn's involvement. Following the raid, the ''Malachite Scent'' disappeared, Clabburn and his crew with it. Investigators searched for signs of the cruiser and the Mugaari but found nothing. Clabburn had escaped, free to enjoy his spoils.<ref name="Rough" />

===Legacy===
{{Quote|He was an old bull when he took that Wolf-man cruiser years back on the Anoat, and I hear that score made him a rich old bull. Rich enough to retire or hide, and if he's still hidden, kid, best let him stay that way.|Fenn Gilbrantes|<ref name="Rough" />}}
Clabburn's exploits gained him legendary status among the history of the Greater Javin. He was the bane of many local authority organizations and rich civilians passing through the area, stamping an enduring seal of negative publicity on the Javin. Although many believed he had [[Death/Legends|died]] following his mysterious disappearance after his final raid on the ''Malachite Scent'', his notoriety continued well into the latter years of the Galactic Civil War.<ref name="Rough" />

[[File:SWM14-RoguesAndVillainsCoverArt.png|thumb|right|330px|The Hoth asteroid field, where both Clabburn and his son would take refuge]]
Clabburn fathered a [[Gender/Legends|male]] offspring during his pirating career. His son, [[Clabburn the Younger]], sought to fashion his own pirating career after that of his father following the Battle of Hoth, some twenty years after the pinnacle of Clabburn the Elder's success, by using his father's resources. Due to the ambiguity of the elder Clabburn's disappearance and the near identical resemblance between the two Mugaari, the younger Clabburn was often mistaken for his father, whom many had believed had made his return to reaping illicit profits. The only physical differences between he and his father were a heavily scarred face and the missing lower half of his left arm, received from a much harsher life than that of the elder Clabburn. However, these differences only served to add to the belief that the original Clabburn had returned, as many theorized he had merely suffered grievous injuries during his years in hiding.<ref name="Rough" />

Clabburn the Younger learned the tricks of the pirating trade from his father while growing up and took measures to have a career that paralleled his predecessor. Like his father, he too took up sanctuary in the Hoth asteroid field, creating his own asteroid facility, [[Airtight Base/Legends|Airtight Base]]. He also used the space slugs that his father had introduced to the field years before to protect his base. The space slugs that the elder Clabburn placed in the Hoth belt remained there for years following his disappearance.<ref name="Rough" /> In the absence of [[Gravity/Legends|gravity]], many grew to enormous sizes, some reaching lengths of 900 [[Meter/Legends|meters]].<ref name="Illustrated" /> Eventually, the slugs grew to a population in the thousands.<ref name="Rough" />

==Personality and traits==
{{Quote|Clabburn?&hellip;Plain mean&mdash;even for a Mugaari.|Fenn Gilbrantes|<ref name="Rough" />}}
In a word, Clabburn was ruthless, a trait not uncommon among the Mugaari, though he gave the concept new meaning. He was the most feared pirate operating in the Greater Javin<ref name="Rough" /> and was known for his merciless treatment of others, especially those who had the unfortunate fate of falling victim to one of his raids. A common raiding routine for he and his forces involved breaching the hull of a captured ship in order to depressurize the interior and kill everyone aboard.<ref name="Illustrated" /> He would often tell his pirates to take as many captives alive as possible, not for ransom purposes, but to kill them. He simply derived pleasure from watching them die.<ref name="Rough" />

As a Mugaari, Clabburn typified the hairy, oily, greenish-skinned physical appearance of the species.<ref name="Illustrated" /> He carried with him an intimidating demeanor at all times.<ref name="Rough" />

==Behind the scenes==
[[File:TISWUcover.jpg|thumb|left|150px|''The Illustrated Star Wars Universe'', where Clabburn was introduced]]
Clabburn the Elder was created by [[Kevin J. Anderson]] for the [[1995]] publication of the sourcebook ''[[The Illustrated Star Wars Universe]]''. Anderson referred to the character simply as "Clabburn," and identified him as a green-skinned humanoid, but did not identify his species.<ref name="Illustrated" />

Clabburn later appeared in the [[2004]] [[Wizards of the Coast]] online ''[[Star Wars: The Roleplaying Game]]'' supplement "[[Rough and Tundra]]," which greatly expanded the character's backstory, identifying him as a Mugaari, and first referring to him as "Clabburn the Elder," after establishing that he had a son, Clabburn the Younger.<ref name="Rough" />
